headline: Energy and Healthcare Leadership Persists While Global Materials and Selected Emerging Markets Build Momentum
market_regime: Selective Rotation with Mixed-Horizon Sector Divergences
executive_summary: Cross-sectional ETF monitoring indicates persistent relative leadership in Biotechnology (XBI) and Energy (XLE), alongside emerging relative strength in Global Materials (MXI), Peru (EPU), and Africa (AFK). Meanwhile, Utilities (XLU) remains in confirmed ROTATION_OUT, and Regional Banks (KRE) exhibits severe deterioration, reaching a 63-bar score low of 26.84. Broad sector divergences persist across Consumer Discretionary, Health Care, and Industrials, while style factor spreads highlight split relative performance across 20-bar and 63-bar horizons.

Relative strength is positive across both horizons at 6.66 percentage points over 20 bars and 9.99 percentage points over 63 bars, with a pending raw state of PERSISTENT_LEADER (1 of 3 confirmation days).

methodology_note: Interpretation uses Python-confirmed trend states that require 3 consecutive daily observations before a new raw condition becomes canonical. Raw conditions remain available as pending early warnings. Evidence also uses deterministic 5-bar score changes, 20- and 63-bar relative strength or pair spreads, persistence metrics, and Python-calculated attention flags including 63-bar rotation-score extrema and material cross-market conflicts.
